chunks: 32 - MUHAMMAD IBN ALI IBN MAHBOOB FROM ABD ALLAH IBN JA'FAR SAID
I wrote to him, meaning Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him): 'It is permissible for a man to pray while a musk mouse is with him.' He wrote back: 'There is no harm in it if it is male.'

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: There is no harm in it

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray with a mouse present according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This correspondence from Imam al-Hadi (peace be upon him) clarifies the fiqh of minor impurities (najis) on the body during prayer, specifically addressing the status of a musk mouse (faarah). The condition that the mouse must be 'male' (dhakiran) reflects the scholarly view that male animals are considered pure (tahir) in their flesh and excrement, whereas females may carry different rulings depending on the school of thought, thus ensuring the prayer remains valid despite the presence of the creature.
